title: Robustness of Gen355 C (extreme negative funding -> long 24 h). Registered after Gen355, before running; descriptive checks (no new adoption trial)

checks.1 Bybit costs + Bybit funding: taker 5.5 bp + half the Bybit spread per side; funding paid / received at Bybit rates
checks.2 Bybit signal: trigger on BYBIT funding settlements < -0.10% (independent venue signal), Bybit costs and funding
checks.3 OKX prices: same positions, OKX hourly returns (57 coins)
checks.5 one hour later: entry one hour after the settlement
checks.6 price vs funding: P&L split into price return and funding received
7 by year, events per year, corr with cascade / delev bounce / premium spike

candidate rule: stays a candidate if 1 and 2 keep every period >= 0.4, the neighbourhood median every period > 0.3, the price part alone is positive in every period, and OKX keeps the sign
